error.message: Sequence "B" has 2 columns but the first has 3. Bootstrap needs an alignment (all rows the same length) because it resamples columns.
The original alignment has pairs with no usable distance (saturated or no comparable sites), so no reference tree can be built. Try the p-distance or another gap policy.
The Jukes–Cantor model cannot be used for protein sequences.
Replicates must be a whole number from 1 to 1000.
Replicates must be a whole number from 1 to 1000.
At most 50,000 alignment columns are supported (got 60,000).
This bootstrap needs about 99.0 billion column comparisons; the limit is 5 billion. Use fewer replicates or fewer sequences.
